evidence.summary: Named generic entrypoints with explicit type_arguments work across declared backends.
The provider still generates identity matchers and static calls because callable identities cannot be invoked directly with heterogeneous typed signatures.

reproduction.instructions: run the current host-generic entrypoint conformance and inspect the declaration-inventory-to-provider path; the named module/function route passes, but no callable-identity plus typed-material route exists

summary: The current typed-call ABI resolves module/function targets and explicit generic type arguments, while declaration-inventory exposes stable callable and signature identities. The runtime has no identity-targeted heterogeneous typed invocation surface; mncs-test still requires transparent generated selector dispatch.

workaround.description: mncs-test generates native provider_inventory.mncs from the compiler declaration inventory; the generator is transparent typed glue, not semantic test policy.
